# Submission checklist

- [x] global theorem statement and quantifiers frozen
- [x] generator, metric, Haar, trace, and lattice conventions explicit
- [x] identity, transition, cut, endpoint, and tail proofs complete
- [x] antipodal radial images distinguished from minimizing geodesics
- [x] primary literature and closest-result comparison updated
- [x] unsupported priority language removed
- [x] exact-rational record, independent checks, and adversarial tests included
- [x] bibliography and all 77 cross-references resolve
- [x] strict lint and 17-page PDF build pass
- [x] all rendered pages inspected
- [x] scope excludes interacting-measure, continuum, and mass-gap claims
- [x] source/PDF archive and SHA-256 sidecar created
